criteria.no: It does not specify the full single-procedure, every-phase-bead coverage: it is silent, speaks generally about phase validation, names only part of the phase, or splits coverage so no procedure covers all beads.
criteria.unclear: It appears to specify one procedure for phase-wide validation, but whether every bead is included or whether there is one procedure remains ambiguous.
criteria.yes: It specifies one validation procedure and says it traverses, checks, or validates every bead belonging to the phase.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` require a single validation procedure to visit every bead that belongs to the phase? A validator, pass, method, or procedure may express the single validation method. Judge only the complete requirement, not conflict.

criteria.no: It does not explicitly rule out one procedure covering the complete phase; silence or incomplete coverage detail is not conflict.
criteria.unclear: It is unclear whether a procedure covers all phase beads or whether a stated split leaves no complete validator.
criteria.yes: It explicitly leaves one or more phase beads uncovered, or assigns disjoint subsets to separate procedures while stating none covers the complete phase.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly rule out a single procedure covering all beads in the phase? Do not infer conflict from silence or missing detail.

criteria.no: The item concerns a different activity and does not affect how phase beads are validated.
criteria.unclear: The item is too vague to determine whether it concerns validation of phase beads.
criteria.yes: The item plans, changes, or depends on a phase bead validation method, whether its coverage is complete, partial, or divided among methods.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` concern the method used to validate bead schemas or otherwise validate beads belonging to the phase? Judge subject overlap only, not whether one method covers all beads.

anchor.statement: A single validation method must validate every bead in the phase.

item.text: Add bead schema validation to atm-bd-orchestration so malformed beads are caught early.
